 AT AMARAVATI  (Special Original Jurisdiction)
 WEDNESDAY,THE THIRD DAY OF DECEMBER  TWO THOUSAND AND TWENTY FIVE  PRESENT  THE HONOURABLE SRI JUSTICE NYAPATHY VIJAY  WRIT PETITION NO: 33297/2025 Between:
T Deepasikha ...PETITIONER  AND The State Of Andhra Pradesh and Others ...RESPONDENT(S)
Counsel for the Petitioner:
1. G R SUDHAKAR Counsel for the Respondent(S):
1. GP FOR SERVICES I The Court made the following:
THE HON'BLE SRI JUSTICE NYAPATHY VIJAY W.P.No.33297 of 2025 O R DE R:
The Writ Petition is filed questioning the action of the Respondents in not considering the representation of the Petitioner dated 08.07.2025 for considering the services regarding the period of suspension of the Petitioner on account of criminal case.

2. The facts leading to filing of the present Writ Petition are as follows:
The Petitioner was appointed as V.R.A. in the year 2009 on compassionate appointment vide Proceedings in ROC No. A3/48/2009, dated 16.02.2009.

Subsequently, the Petitioner was suspended from service on 16.09.2014 in connection with Cr.No.54 of 2016 of Kuppam P.S., registered for the offenses punishable under Sections 417, 420, 498-B, and Cr/w 34 IPC.

sentences.text: Petitioner continued during the pendency of the criminal case.

After the Petitioner was acquitted in the criminal case, i.e., S.C. No. 212 of 2016 on the file of the Assistant Sessions Judge, Palamaner, the order of suspension of the Petitioner was revoked vide Proceedings in Roc. A3/251/2014, dated 01.05.2021, and the Petitioner was reinstated into service as V.R.A., Dandapalle Cluster, Gangavaram Mandal.
Thereupon, the Petitioner submitted a representation dated 08.07.2025 for counting of her service for the purpose of promotion to the higher post.
As the representation of the Petitioner is not being considered, the present Writ Petition is filed.

3. Sri S. Raju, learned Assistant Government Pleader, would submit that the representation of the Petitioner is under consideration and necessary action will be taken as per G.O.Ms.No.1849 Revenue (VO) Department, dated 28.10.2005.

In the light of the submissions made, the Writ Petition is disposed of with the following directions:
i) The Respondent Authorities are directed to act on the representation of the Petitioner dated 08.07.2025 as expeditiously as possible, preferably within a period of three weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this Order.
ii) There shall be no order as to costs.
As a sequel, the miscellaneous petitions, if any, pending in this Petition shall stand closed.
